notes.title: Thank you!
notes.content:
As the October 2024 Edition of Steam NextFest is coming to an end, we would like to thank everyone for playing our demo as well as supporting us by wishlisting our game. 

We are working hard and putting in all our efforts to deliver the game packed with mystery and challenge within the world of Enci's Solution.

We are still keeping the demo active on Steam! 
But for now, what is your overall feedback of our demo? Give us either tiny or extreme amounts of details in our discussions or even below this post!

Also come join our discord server! We welcome all kinds of players.


Here's the link: https://discord.gg/darkemerald



- Dark Emerald Team

notes.title: Enci's Solution Demo Now Live on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

The demo for [b]Enci's Solution[/b] is finally live on steam! You can head over to our steam page and begin your journey! We're very excited for our international debut, and we hope everyone has a good time!

The demo will be up throughout the duration of Tokyo Game Show 2024.

We also have a discord, with newly added channels to discuss all things Enci's Solution. Hop in and be a part of our welcoming community! 

You can access it through the following link: https://discord.gg/darkemerald


- Dark Emerald Team
